paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Error rate for slots
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error rates for different slot types. The chart contains 13 slices, each representing a slot type with its corresponding error rate. The slices are labeled “type” (2.00%), “range” (2.20%), “class” (2.40%), “city” (2.60%), “destination” (3.00%), “location” (3.80%), "intent" (3.80%), “time” (4.10%), “size” (4.20%), “name” (5.20%), “genre” (13.50%), “to” (14.50%), “from” (17.00%), “date” (19.30%), and “passengers” (1.10%). Each slice is colored differently, with shades of pink, yellow, green and blue being prominent. Percentage labels are located directly inside each slice. The segments appear to be visually ordered from largest to smallest, starting with “date” and ending with “passengers”. The chart does not appear to use a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized or offset.
